text.tspan: .param tdv=1 tdt=1 fn1=50 omega_n={2*pi*fn1} ; should always be present
.options vntol=1m abstol=1u ; for accuracy voltage and current
.options meascplxfmt=polar ; for meas AC values in polar format
*.options logparams ; To put input parameters of all devices to the log file (Version>24.x)
Scroll to the end of the file
To see the simulation voltage results simply click on the lines
To see the currents click on the input pins of the device
The left buses measurement pins shows the line to line voltages
The right buses measurement pins shows the line to ground voltages
